lines.text: - The `useQRCodeSVG` claim is Must because the diff shows a file under `src/` in a test PR and the comment in the hunk names the fresh `options` object. The note that the dropped options change nothing today is Good because it needs the caller in `src/components/shared/QRCode.tsx`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár

lines.text: - The muted host audio is Good because it needs `src/routes/game/host.$gameId.tsx`, which the diff does not touch. The Remote shell claim is Must because the spec comment and commit `5a0cd31` state the cause.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: rewrite every expected.md from the pull request
lines.text: - The `E2E_UI` claim comes from commits `94eb489` and `7d22c29`; commit `8133348` removed the skip, and the PR body still describes it. `e2e/README.md` at head says `pnpm test:e2e:ui` uses the same webServer, which matches the code.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: rewrite every expected.md from the pull request
lines.text: - The `.env.local` deletion affects host runs only. Docker runs copy the repo without `.env*` and mount only snapshots and reports.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add parts cases; accept a page-object part in cigster-99
lines.text: - The page objects and the visual-spec migration could have been their own PR before the living-room spec, so a refactor part for them is fine, even though the living-room spec imports `HostPage`, `TvPage`, `RemotePage`, and `PlayerPage`. Past runs often called the three changed goldens pure moves.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: allow up to 18 groups in cigster-99
lines.text: - `parts` 3 to 8 has slack: the harness can fold into the story part, and the snapshot folders, the QR fix, or the page objects with the visual-spec migration can stand alone. `groups` 6 to 18 has the same slack: groups 4 and 5 can merge, and groups 1 and 3 can merge. Groups 1 and 3 hold over 20 files, so they can also split by surface, each page object with the visual spec that moved onto it, or by layer; past runs did both and reached 17 groups.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: the grader accepts the main fact; shorter Must items
lines.text: - `together` holds the living-room spec with its seed and factory. `apart` keeps the living-room spec away from the snapshot moves, the audit, and the migrated `admin.spec.ts`, the QR hook away from the snapshot moves, and the audit away from the page objects.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Skill, glossary, and eval: attention plus document lookFor
lines.text: - Homes: the `.env.local` deletion fits a `risk` attention on the startup group, the 12.5 second wait and the forced `pause` write a `tradeoff` attention on the living-room group, and `useQRCodeSVG` and the dependency refresh a `product` attention on their own parts, or each group summary. The `E2E_UI` claim is a document `lookFor` bullet, because it compares the PR body with head.
